Word7000 Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 28, 2026

What Word7000 stores

Word7000 stores vocabulary progress, saved words, review status, custom word sets, display preferences, and basic daily activity records used to keep learning progress in sync. It does not track you across other companies' apps or websites, show ads, or sell or share your data for advertising.

Account sign-in

Word7000 creates a temporary guest identity when the app first opens. You can sign in with Apple, Google, or an email address and password. Word7000 keeps your account identifier, your email address, and, if you choose to share it with Sign in with Apple, your name, only to connect and restore your learning data. Passwords are handled by our account service and are never stored by the app. If you ask for a password reset, a reset link is emailed to that address. With Sign in with Apple, our server keeps a token from Apple only so that deleting your account can also end Word7000's access to your Apple ID.

Local data

Display preferences and a local copy of learning progress are stored on your device. Removing the app or clearing its storage may remove the connection to a temporary guest identity. Signing out or deleting your account also removes the AI answers saved on the device.

Cloud sync

Guest progress may be backed up to the temporary identity used on that device. Signing in is required for scanning, custom sets, data tools, and reliable restoration on another device.

Word7000 Plus purchases

Subscriptions are sold and billed by Apple; Word7000 never receives your payment details. To unlock Plus features on our server, the app sends Apple's signed record of your active subscription with AI requests. The server checks Apple's signature and records the subscription's original transaction number together with the accounts that use it, so one subscription is not shared among many people. If you set up the App Store's notices, Apple tells our server when a purchase is refunded or revoked, and Plus ends for that subscription. Your free trial's start date is kept with your account so a reinstall does not restart it.

Lock Screen streak reminders

If you enable Lock Screen streak reminders, Word7000 stores an Apple device token, your streak deadline, daily goal and today's progress, reminder time, interface language, and time zone. This data is used only to start the countdown you requested. A device token that Apple reports as no longer valid is switched off, and each account keeps at most five registered devices.

Optional speaking recordings and on-device suggestions

In versions that include recording practice, microphone access is requested only when you choose to record. Each recording is limited to 60 seconds and is kept in protected temporary storage on your device, not uploaded. Leaving the recording screen deletes it; abandoned temporary recordings are removed when the app next launches. Answers and suggestions remain only in the current practice session and are not added to account sync.

Transcription uses on-device recognition only when supported for your device and language. You may choose to download language assets from Apple; the app does not upload your recording for recognition. System keyboard dictation is separate and follows Apple's settings.

Photos of word lists are read on your device and are not uploaded.

Online AI (Anthropic's Claude)

The speaking coach, word explanations and questions about a word, quiz explanations, scan tidy-up, word fill-in suggestions and learning insights use Claude, an online AI model provided by Anthropic, PBC (United States), once you are signed in and agree in the app; guests and anyone who declines use Apple's on-device model where available. You can turn online AI off at any time in AI and recording.

When online AI is used, only the text needed for that request is sent: your typed or transcribed answer and its practice question, the text recognised from a scanned word list, the word you look up and any question you type about it, or, when you ask for learning insights, a summary of the last 14 days (practice counts, quiz accuracy, streak and up to 12 words you forget most often). Recordings, photos, your name, email address and your full learning history are not sent. Requests pass through our own account server, which checks that you are signed in and counts requests per account per day (kept for seven days) to share the service fairly; it does not store their content. Anthropic processes the text to return a suggestion under its commercial data terms. If you agreed to the earlier Groq-based online AI, the app asks again before sending anything to Anthropic. Word explanations, answers to your questions and quiz explanations are kept on your iPhone so they reopen without being generated again; they are not uploaded to your account. AI suggestions may contain mistakes.

Apart from the daily request count above, the app does not collect AI capability, answer, or satisfaction statistics. It may fetch a small public feature-control file, without including account identifiers, recordings, or answers. Hosting providers necessarily receive ordinary network connection information for that request.

Data deletion

You can permanently delete the current Word7000 identity and its data from the app settings. This removes learning progress, custom sets, daily activity records, AI request counts, Plus subscription links, and Lock Screen reminder registrations connected to that identity. Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store subscription; cancel it in your iPhone's Settings under your Apple Account > Subscriptions.
